item.description:

item.title: Deebo Samuel: Not likely to play Sunday
item.description:
According to GM John Lynch, Samuel (hamstring) is unlikely to be available for Sunday's game against the Raiders, Matt Maiocco of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.

item.title: Mike Evans: Likely to sit Sunday per GM
item.description:
Evans (Achilles) isn't expected to play Sunday against the Raiders, 49ers GM John Lynch said on KNBR radio Thursday, Matt Maiocco of NBC Sports Bay Area reports.

item.title: Sam Darnold: Considered week-to-week
item.description:
